timeline.text: Ten of my oldest feature videos still looked like a dark computer terminal while the rest of the site had moved on.
A new visual style only proves itself on real content, not a single demo.
So Claude rewrote all ten clips in one parallel batch.
Each was re-rendered and uploaded back to its exact old link, so nothing broke.
Now every clip gets a second run too - one a day for ten days, instead of all at once.
